title: Millennium Ceramics master catalog manifest
purpose: Canonical inventory entry point. Product records remain in source-specific datasets so original supplier provenance is never overwritten.

datasets.scope: Chinese supplier group only (Eagle Ceramics scan-only records, Allye Polished/Rustic/Milano/Wall/Floor tile catalogs, and one Polisa tile catalog)
datasets.publication_rule: Only records with individual verified display assets are customer-facing.
Every record must preserve a source catalogue/page reference and a verified supplier display image.

datasets.scope: Unpublished source-text candidates from new bathroom catalogues
datasets.publication_rule: Not customer-facing until visually verified against source page and image.

datasets.scope: Eagle Ceramics / ECOEAGLE (Guangdong Eagle Brand Group) porcelain tile, SPC flooring and wallboard collections, plus 13 unbranded-on-page single-collection tile sheets (brand not shown anywhere in their source pages, so left unconfirmed)
datasets.publication_rule: Records with display_asset_status 'source_lifestyle_image_only' or data_confidence 'collection_identified_pending_individual_sku_extraction' are not customer-facing until individually SKU-verified.

datasets.scope: TAU Cerámica (Spain) porcelain tile, metal mosaic and large-format (Big Sizes 120x280) slab collections
datasets.publication_rule: Every record must preserve a source catalogue/page reference and a verified supplier display image.

source_separation: Supplier groups must not be merged, renamed or inferred from display artwork. Chinese sources remain separate from TAU, SEBACH, Mitrani and all other supplier groups.
